subject: Helios Labs — marketing visibility swap for one-time credit (approval needed)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Helios Labs — marketing visibility swap for one-time credit (approval needed)

Team — quick summary and ask: Helios (prospect moving to PO) has pushed back hard on any publicity/case-study language in our SOW. Their procurement asks: remove all logo and quote rights; they want strict confidentiality. Helios is a strategic target (IoT analytics, potential enterprise expansion), total first-year ARR ~ $600k.

Current negotiation posture: they will sign if we remove publicity clause AND provide a one-time implementation credit. They are asking for ~20% credit which is material (~$120k). I think we can take a trade: ask them to permit a short customer quote and logo on a customer page (not a full case study) in exchange for a capped credit.

Requesting approval to offer up to 15% one-time credit (applied as invoice adjustment) if Helios agrees to: 1) provide a short written quote (<= 2 sentences) approved by their legal and marketing teams, 2) allow Redwood to display their logo on our customer page and in a short blog excerpt, and 3) review/approve final marketing assets (standard 5-business-day review). Legal redlines will need to be limited (no irrevocable rights, approval rights for Helios retained).

Attached: latest SOW (v3), their logo guidelines, and pricing summary.

Why this matters: the account is high-touch and referenceable in industrial IoT vertical. Allowing a modest credit for limited visibility unlocks a strategic reference and helps sales motions into their peers.

Asks: Laura — can you confirm whether the proposed marketing rights (limited quote + logo + 5-day approval) are acceptable and what language you would need?
Vivek/Marissa — please approve a ceiling of 15% one-time credit if legal signs off on the limited rights. If not approved, I'll propose a smaller non-financial concession (2 weeks free onboarding hours) instead.

Thanks — Karthik

Attachments (stubs): Helios_SOW_v3.pdf (26 pages), Helios_logo_guidelines.pdf (8 pages), pricing_summary.xlsx (4KB)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helios Labs — marketing visibility swap for one-time credit (approval needed)

Karthik — thanks for the summary and attachments. High level: we can accept a limited visibility arrangement but need to bake in protections to avoid open-ended rights and downstream redistribution. Proposed legal guardrails:

- Rights scope: Redwood receives a non-exclusive, revocable license to use Helios logo and a short written testimonial (<= 2 sentences) across Redwood marketing channels and sales collateral.
- Approval: Helios has sole approval over final assets with a five-business-day review window. If no response, approval is considered granted.
- Duration: Rights granted for 12 months from asset approval, renewable by mutual consent.
- No indemnity/ownership transfer: Redwood does not claim ownership of the testimonial or logo beyond the limited license.
- Take-down: Helios may request removal with 30 days' notice; credit not refundable after removal.

I will prepare a short addendum clause to attach to the SOW reflecting the above. Two red flags to call out: do NOT accept irrevocable or perpetual publicity rights; do NOT promise placement in third-party press without separate approval; and ensure the credit is a one-time invoice adjustment (not a long-term price reduction) so it doesn't change ARR calculations.

If you want me to push more on the 12-month limit to 6 months for product privacy reasons, we can, but 12 months is reasonable for marketing ROI.

I'll draft the addendum and circulate.

- Laura

Karthik/Laura — thanks. I'm comfortable approving a commercial concession up to 15% one-time credit on the first invoice provided the legal addendum contains the protections Laura outlined (12-month term, revocable rights, approval window). A few notes:

- Cap the credit at 15% or $90k (whichever is lower).
- Credit must be applied as a one-time invoice adjustment in the first billing period; finance needs a billing note.
- Marketing must commit to delivery timelines (case excerpt and logo live within 90 days of contract signature) or the credit is void.

Marissa — can you sign off on the credit cap and marketing timeline? This is time-sensitive; Helios procurement expects an answer by EOD Thursday.

If Marissa approves, Karthik please share the addendum and the specific credit mechanics (invoice instructions) and I'll notify finance to reserve the concession.

- Vivek
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helios Labs — marketing visibility swap for one-time credit (approval needed)

Approving the concession with the following firm conditions:

1) Credit: up to 15% one-time credit, capped at $90,000, applied as an invoice adjustment on the first invoice. No retroactive or multi-period price change.
2) Rights: Legal addendum per Laura's language (12-month revocable license; 5 business day approval; take-down clause). Marketing must review final assets for brand fit.
3) Timeline: Marketing (cc'd) to produce the joint excerpt and place the logo on our customer page within 90 days of signature. If marketing cannot meet the 90-day deadline, credit is void unless an extension is mutually agreed in writing.
4) Acceptance: Helios must provide the testimonial and logo within 14 days of signature; Redwood will not draft a quote on their behalf.

If Helios refuses the limited visibility terms, do NOT give any financial credit. Offer instead: 2 weeks free onboarding support and a 30-day rollout assistance credit (non-monetary).

Karthik — please communicate this to procurement and attach Laura's addendum language in the DocuSign packet. Finance to be notified once Helios confirms in writing.

Thanks — Marissa
